questions.prompt: A block of mass $5\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the block and the plane is $\mu = 0.25$. Calculate the normal reaction $R$ exerted by the plane on the block and find the maximum available limiting friction force $F_{\text{lim}}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction $R$ and the limiting friction force $F_{\text{lim}}$, giving each value to 3 significant figures.

questions.prompt: A particle of mass $4\text{ kg}$ slides down a rough plane inclined at $25^\circ$ to the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the particle and the plane is $\mu = 0.30$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the friction force acting on the particle and determine its acceleration down the plane.

questions.prompt: A particle of mass $0.8\text{ kg}$ is projected up a rough plane inclined at $10^\circ$ to the horizontal. The coefficient of friction is $\mu = 0.40$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the deceleration of the particle while it is moving up the plane.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $8\text{ kg}$ accelerates down a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal at $2.4\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the friction force acting on the block and deduce the coefficient of friction $\mu$.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $6\text{ kg}$ is pulled up a rough plane inclined at $20^\circ$ to the horizontal by a force $P$ acting parallel to the plane. The coefficient of friction is $\mu = 0.35$ and the block moves up the plane with constant speed.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction $R$ and the magnitude of the pulling force $P$.

questions.prompt: A crate of mass $10\text{ kg}$ is pulled up a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal by a force of $120\text{ N}$ acting at an angle of $15^\circ$ above the surface of the plane. The coefficient of friction between the crate and the plane is $\mu = 0.20$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the normal reaction force $R$ exerted by the plane on the crate and find the magnitude of the friction force $F$.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is released from rest at the top of a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. The plane has length $3.6\text{ m}$, and the coefficient of friction between the block and the plane is $\mu = 0.346$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of the block down the plane is $2.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the speed of the block when it reaches the bottom of the plane and the time taken for this descent.

questions.prompt: A sled of mass $12\text{ kg}$ is pulled up a rough slope inclined at $20^\circ$ to the horizontal by a rope parallel to the slope. The coefficient of friction between the sled and the slope is $\mu = 0.40$, and the sled accelerates up the slope at $2.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction $R$ exerted by the slope and the friction force $F$ opposing the motion.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: By forming an equation of motion along the slope, calculate the tension $T$ in the rope, and find the work done against friction over a distance of $5.0\text{ m}$.

questions.prompt: A particle of mass $0.5\text{ kg}$ is projected up a line of greatest slope of a rough plane inclined at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.6$ and $\cos\alpha = 0.8$. The initial speed of the particle is $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and the coefficient of friction between the particle and the plane is $\mu = 0.25$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the deceleration of the particle while moving up the plane is $8.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and find the distance it travels before coming to instantaneous rest.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Determine whether the particle remains at rest at its highest point or slides back down the plane. If it slides down, calculate its acceleration down the plane.

questions.prompt: A box of mass $15\text{ kg}$ is dragged up a rough ramp inclined at $22^\circ$ to the horizontal by a cable exerting a tension of $140\text{ N}$ at an angle of $18^\circ$ above the ramp. The coefficient of friction between the box and the ramp is $\mu = 0.30$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the normal reaction force $R$ exerted by the ramp on the box, and find the resulting friction force $F$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the box up the ramp and find the speed of the box after it has moved $6.0\text{ m}$ from rest.

questions.prompt: Two particles $P$ and $Q$, of masses $3\text{ kg}$ and $5\text{ kg}$ respectively, are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley at the top of a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Particle $P$ is held on the rough inclined plane, where the coefficient of friction is $\mu = 0.20$. Particle $Q$ hangs freely vertically below the pulley. The system is released from rest with the string taut.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the friction force acting on particle $P$ while moving up the plane is $5.196\text{ N}$ (to 4 significant figures), and find the component of weight parallel to the plane.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: By setting up equations of motion for both particles, find the common acceleration of the system and the tension $T$ in the string.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $4\text{ kg}$ is pulled from rest at point $A$ up a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal by a constant force $P = 50\text{ N}$ parallel to the plane. The coefficient of friction between the block and the plane is $\mu = 0.25$. After the block has traveled a distance of $6.0\text{ m}$ up the plane to point $B$, the force $P$ is suddenly removed.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the block during the first stage while force $P$ acts, and calculate its speed at point $B$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the deceleration of the block during the second stage after force $P$ is removed, and determine the further distance $BC$ the block travels before coming to instantaneous rest at point $C$.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the block as it slides back down the plane from $C$, and calculate its speed when it returns to $A$.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is placed on a rough plane inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\tan\theta = 0.75$ (so $\sin\theta = 0.6$ and $\cos\theta = 0.8$). The coefficient of friction between $A$ and the plane is $\mu = 0.25$. Particle $A$ is connected to a particle $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth pulley at the top of the incline. Particle $B$ hangs freely $1.8\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. The system is released from rest with $A$ at a distance greater than $3\text{ m}$ from the pulley.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Form equations of motion for particles $A$ and $B$, and show that the magnitude of their acceleration while $B$ is descending is $2.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the speed of $B$ immediately before it hits the ground, and calculate the tension in the string during this motion.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: When $B$ reaches the ground, the string becomes slack. Calculate the deceleration of $A$ after the string goes slack, and determine the total distance that particle $A$ travels up the plane from its initial position until coming to instantaneous rest.
